items.what: Codebook 기반 activation 압축과 table lookup으로 distributed edge inference의 communication-computation overlap을 개선.
items.relation: H1 (통신이 prefill의 25~45%)의 타당성 검증과 관련; 통신 압축이 straggler 대기를 극복하는지가 핵심.
items.gap: 우리의 H1은 straggler 대기가 순수 전송보다 크다고 가정하는데, TRACE의 VQ/table-lookup 오버헤드가 CPU-only 환경에서 실제로 이익인지 불명확.
hypothesis_notes: H1: prefill 시간의 25~45 %가 통신+barrier 대기이며, 그중 대기(straggler) 가 순수 전송보다 크다
items.title: TRACE: Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding for Communication-efficient Distributed Edge Inference
items.abstract: Distributed Transformer inference across co-located edge devices is fundamentally communication-bound, as exchanging activations between sequence-parallel partitions dominates inference latency under commodity edge bandwidths. Existing compression schemes reduce this cost but retain a structural bottleneck: the received data must still undergo key/value projection before attention can proceed, serializing computation behind communication. This paper presents Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding (Trace), a framework that addresses these limitations. Trace places a Vector Quantizer

items.what: Layer-wise delayed eviction으로 KV cache 메모리 peak를 감소시키는 prefill 아키텍처를 제시.
items.relation: 우리 가설과 무관 (메모리 관리 vs 시간 최적화).
items.gap: GPU 환경, long-context (64K+) 문제이며, 우리는 CPU-only, short-context (0.5~4K) 체제에서 메모리 peak가 병목이 아님.
items.title: TideKV: Delayed KV Eviction via Layer-Wise Chunked Prefill for Memory-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
items.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is important for modern intelligent applications but remains constrained by peak memory during prompt prefill. Existing KV cache compression reduces decoding memory but typically requires full-prompt prefill to preserve global context, retaining a high construction peak. Online chunk-level eviction lowers memory earlier but selects before each layer has observed the complete prompt, potentially degrading cache construction and decoding. items.what: Streaming video QA를 위해 query 도착 시점에 따라 video segment를 다른 representation level로 유지하는 adaptive precomputation 시스템.
items.relation: 우리 가설과 무관 (streaming vision 시스템 vs 텍스트 prefill).
items.gap: Vision 전처리, streaming 시스템이며, 우리는 LLM batch prefill 최적화.
items.title: StreamAhead: Real-Time Streaming Video Question Answering via Adaptive Precomputation
items.abstract: Real-time streaming video question answering with vision-language models must answer queries that arrive at any time with low latency while sustaining the video-processing rate required by the application. Existing systems construct key-value (KV) caches for the entire video as it arrives, although a query typically uses only a few of the preceding frames as evidence. all.what: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) 메모리를 포함한 이종 메모리 계층의 LLM 추론 성능을 시뮬레이션.
all.relation: 우리 가설과 무관 (메모리 계층 설계 vs 연산-통신 최적화).
all.gap: GPU 가속기용 HBM+HBF 계층 구조이며, 우리는 CPU-only 시스템에서 메모리 bandwidth가 병목이 아님.
all.title: HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs
all.abstract: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) has recently emerged as a promising technology that provides terabyte-scale accelerator-local capacity at bandwidths approaching HBM, with a potential cost-per-bit advantage over HBM. However, its NAND foundation brings long latency, out-of-place updates, and finite write endurance directly into the accelerator memory hierarchy, making its effects on performance and lifetime difficult to predict. all.what: 지리적으로 분산된 region 간 KV cache 재사용을 위해 prefix 기반 cache discovery를 상수시간 로컬 lookup으로 구현.
all.relation: 우리 가설과 무관 (캐시 공유 vs 단일 prefill 최적화).
all.gap: Internet-scale geo-distributed serving이며, 우리는 local SBC 클러스터의 단일 요청 prefill.
all.title: KVCompass: A Discovery Plane for Internet-Scale Prefix Cache Sharing in LLM Serving
all.abstract: KV cache reuse is one of the most effective ways to reduce LLM inference cost, but today its benefits are largely confined to a single cluster. When a provider serves the same model across geographically distributed regions, each region may repeatedly prefill the same popular prefixes, wasting GPU time and increasing time-to-first-token (TTFT). Exploiting reuse across regions involves discovering which worker currently holds a reusable KV cache for each request's prefix. all.what: Perturbed threshold retrieval로 sparse attention의 error를 이론적으로 보장하면서 decoding을 가속.
all.relation: 우리 가설과 무관 (decoding 가속 vs prefill 최적화, attention sparsity vs MLP 병목).
all.gap: Long-context (16K~128K) decoding이며, 우리는 short-context (0.5~4K) prefill에서 H2가 O(S²)을 지배적 아님이라고 함.
all.title: Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval
all.abstract: Sparse attention speeds up long-context decoding by reading few keys of the KV cache, but existing methods do not control the error of a query, and on real KV caches their errors have heavy tails. We show that perturbing the score of every key with an independent Exp(1) variable turns threshold retrieval into sampling keys with probability proportional to their attention weights. all.what: Gated DeltaNet-2 기반 memory-native 모델 아키텍처로 메모리를 모델 계산 내에 내재화하여 KV cache 대체.
all.relation: 우리 가설과 무관 (모델 학습 및 아키텍처 설계 vs inference-time 최적화).
all.gap: Foundation model 학습과 새로운 아키텍처 설계이며, 우리는 주어진 모델 (LLaMA 등)의 prefill 연산 최적화.
all.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
all.abstract: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. all.what: CXL과 Ethernet을 결합한 purpose-built memory pooling 디바이스로 GPU/CPU에 TB급 메모리 용량과 높은 대역폭 제공.
all.relation: 우리 가설과 무관 (메모리 인프라 설계 vs 연산 최적화).
all.gap: GPU/고성능 시스템용 CXL 기반 인프라이며, 우리는 라즈베리파이급 CPU-only SBC와 1GbE 이더넷.
all.title: CMM-MP: A Novel Memory Pooling Architecture using Purpose-built Memory Device with CXL and Ethernet
all.abstract: CXL Memory Module - Memory Pooling (CMM-MP) introduces a novel memory pooling architecture to meet the unique requirements of emerging memory-intensive workloads. This industry-first, purpose-built memory-pooling device combines the benefits of Compute Express Link (CXL) with the scalability and cost advantages of Ethernet. Multiple CMM-MP devices together provide a flexible, composable, and disaggregated memory expansion solution. The CMM-MP enables 100s of TB capacity for GPU/CPU applications without modifications.
